message.content: Which modules does billing-core depend on now that the ledger split landed?

content.text: billing-core imports ledger-api and pricing directly. ledger-api depends on ledger-store, and pricing depends on catalog. notifications depends on billing-core for the invoice-issued event, so it sits downstream of everything else.

message.content: And where are we on the rollout, and what did the error rates look like?

content.text: Rollout: phase 1 (internal tenants) finished on 3 November, phase 2 (5 percent of tenants) started on 4 November, phase 3 (50 percent) is planned for 10 November and phase 4 (everyone) for 17 November. Error rates per phase so far: 0.4 percent in phase 1, 0.9 percent on the first day of phase 2 and 0.6 percent on the second day.
